name: NeuRBF
aliases: Neural Fields Representation with Adaptive Radial Basis Functions
definition: A hybrid neural field model that enhances representation accuracy and compactness by combining adaptive radial basis functions (RBFs) with grid-based RBF interpolation.
summary: NeuRBF is a hybrid neural field model that enhances volume rendering accuracy by combining adaptive radial basis functions with grid-based interpolation for flexible spatial adaptivity.
